style: Intimate, sad and quiet music in an abandoned switchboard exchange at the edge of space, late at night. Soft felt piano plays a sparse melancholic minor phrase over a cold analog synthesizer pad and a low sustained sub-bass drone; slow tape echoes, distant glass bells, a lonely cello and the quiet tick of an old relay.
